48332.meaning1: name of an ascetic; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in quick realization; Bāhiya Dārucīriya
48332.commentary: (ANa) khipp'ābhiññānan'ti khippaṃ adhigata-abhiññānaṃ dārucīriyatthero aggo'ti dasseti. ayañ'hi thero saṃkhittadhammadesanāpariyosāne arahattaṃ pāpuṇi, maggaphalānaṃ parikammakiccaṃ n'āhosi. tasmā khipp'ābhiññānaṃ aggo nāma jāto. bāhiyaraṭṭhe pana jātattā bāhiyo'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi. so aparabhāge dārucīraṃ nivāsesi. tasmā dārucīriyo nāma jāto. (UDa) dasame bāhiyo'ti tassa nāmaṃ. dārucīriyo'ti dārumayacīro.

examples.text: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa bhagavato imāya saṃkhittāya dhammadesanāya tāva'd'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ khipp'ābhiññānaṃ yadidaṃ bāhiyo dārucīriyo.
kathañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu?
evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, cha kho, āvuso, ajjhattikāni āyatanāni eko anto, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni dutiyo anto, viññāṇaṃ majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.
tena hi, bhaṇe, yo bāhiresu janapadesu āyo sañjāyati tato upaḍḍhaṃ antepure pavesetha, upaḍḍhaṃ tatth'eva dānaṃ detha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānan'ti.
kiṃ te jaṭāhi dummedha, kiṃ te ajinasāṭiyā, abbhantaraṃ te gahanaṃ, bāhiraṃ parimajjasī'ti.
kadā nu kaṭṭhe ca tiṇe latā ca, khandhe ime'haṃ amite ca dhamme, ajjhattikān'eva ca bāhirāni ca, samaṃ tuleyyaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.

48381.commentary: (MNa) bāhukan'ti idam'eva hi ettha vacanaṃ tadatthadīpakaṃ, sesāni visesatthadīpakāni. yath'eva hi bāhukaṃ, evaṃ adhikakk'ādīni'pi loko gacchati nhānena pāpaṃ pavāhetuṃ.

examples.text: gacchati pana bhavaṃ gotamo bāhukaṃ nadiṃ sināyitun'ti? kiṃ, brāhmaṇa, bāhukāya nadiyā? kiṃ bāhukā nadī karissatī'ti?
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idaṃ, bhante, kapilavatthu iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca bāhujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhabyūhaṃ.

na bāhuppacālakaṃ antaraghare gantabbaṃ. bāhuṃ paggahetvā gantabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca bāhuppacālakaṃ antaraghare gacchati bāhuṃ olambento, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

upako palagaṇḍo ca, pukkusāti ca te tayo, bhaddiyo khaṇḍadevo ca, bāhuraggi ca siṅgiyo. te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.
